form.label: Cyber Data Catalog - Browse
form.description: Every tenant x index x sourcetype we know about, what tier it is, who owns it, and whether it is actually flowing.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | stats count by uhgid ae_name | eval ae_name=ae_name." (".uhgid.")" | sort ae_name
| inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | stats count by domain
| inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | where status="active" | stats count

| inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | where status="active" | eval o=if(isnotnull(technical_owner) AND technical_owner!="",1,0) | stats sum(o) as owned, count as total | eval pct=round(owned/total*100,1) | fields pct

| inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | where declared_tier="Tier 0" | eval c=if(contract_status="approved",1,0) | stats sum(c) as ok, count as total | eval pct=if(total=0,0,round(ok/total*100,1)) | fields pct
| inputlookup dc_shadow_classification_lookup | stats count by classification

panel.title: Unmatched/novel sourcetypes needing a new contract (click a row to reject it instead)

search.query: | inputlookup dc_shadow_classification_lookup | where classification="UNMATCHED_NOVEL" | stats sum(events_24h) as events_24h by uhgid, sourcetype, index | sort - events_24h

| inputlookup dc_shadow_classification_lookup | where classification IN ("CONTRACT_MATCHED_EXACT","CONTRACT_MATCHED_OTHER_TENANT") | eval cde_approved=coalesce(cde_approved,"false") | table dataset_id uhgid sourcetype index classification cde_approved exact_ticket any_ticket events_24h | sort cde_approved - events_24h

panel.title: Malformed or Rejected sourcetypes by tenant - needs source-side cleanup

search.query: | inputlookup dc_shadow_classification_lookup | where classification IN ("MALFORMED_SOURCETYPE","REJECTED") | stats sum(events_24h) as events_24h, dc(sourcetype) as distinct_bad_sourcetypes, values(classification) as classification by uhgid | sort - events_24h

panel.title: Tenant x Domain coverage (six-domain federated model)

search.query: | inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | where status="active" | search uhgid=$tenant|s$ | eval flowing=0 | lookup dc_observed_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT last_seen | eval flowing=if(isnotnull(last_seen) AND (now()-last_seen)<86400,1,0) | chart sum(flowing) as flowing count as cataloged over ae_name by domain

| inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | search uhgid=$tenant|s$ domain=$domain|s$ declared_tier=$tier|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | lookup dc_observed_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT last_seen events_24h | lookup dc_baselines_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT median_events mad_events | `dc_default_silence` | eval silence_min=if(isnull(last_seen),null(),round((now()-last_seen)/60,1)) | eval health=case(isnull(last_seen),"NEVER_SEEN", silence_min>max_silence_minutes,"DATA_DOWN", isnotnull(median_events) AND events_24h<(median_events-4*mad_events),"VOLUME_LOW", 1=1,"OK") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table dataset_id ae_name domain index sourcetype declared_tier proposed_tier health events_24h last_seen technical_owner contract_status schema_version gate1_normalization gate2_detection gate3_soc enterprise_ready | sort declared_tier ae_name sourcetype
